name: Stock Breakout Screener
shortDescription: Scan NSE and US stocks for breakout candidates. Rank the shortlist by relative volume and breakout percentage.
features: Scan NSE and US stocks
Rank candidates by relative volume and breakout percentage
Set minimum relative volume and average daily volume
Choose the consolidation lookback period
Send alerts to Telegram with your own bot
whatYouGet: Complete source code, installation guide, and setup instructions.

faqs.question: Does it trade automatically?
faqs.answer: No, this is a screener that alerts you to potential setups for your review.

faqs.question: Can I use it on Mac or Windows?
faqs.answer: Yes, it runs on any system supporting Python.

name: Falling Wedge Screener
shortDescription: Find falling wedge patterns in NIFTY 500 and S&P 500 stocks. Inspect each pattern on a candlestick chart.
features: Scan NIFTY 500 and S&P 500 stocks
Score pattern fit from 0 to 100; this is not a probability of profit
Scan 15-minute, 1-hour, 4-hour, and daily charts
View detected wedges on candlestick charts
Inspect containment, convergence, and downslope metrics
whatYouGet: Complete source code (Python FastAPI backend, React frontend) and setup guide.

faqs.question: Is it a live feed?
faqs.answer: Refresh frequency and data delay depend on the market data source you configure.

name: Crypto Breakout Scanner
shortDescription: Screen Hyperliquid perpetuals using relative volume, EMA alignment, and VWAP. Send matching entries to Telegram.
features: Scan Hyperliquid crypto perpetuals
Filter by relative volume, EMA alignment, and VWAP
Compare charts across timeframes
Refresh scans and send Telegram alerts
Set thresholds for 24-hour price change and recent momentum
whatYouGet: Complete source code and instructions to run the screener locally.

faqs.question: Does it require API keys for data?
faqs.answer: It uses Hyperliquid's public API, no keys required for data.

name: Insider Transactions Dashboard
shortDescription: Review reported insider purchases, sales, and pledges in Indian and US stocks. Filter the records and export your shortlist.
features: Review reported insider transactions in India and the US
Filter purchases, sales, and pledges
Filter by role, including promoter and director
Inspect transaction flags such as off-market gifts and suspect prices
Export records to CSV or Excel
whatYouGet: Complete source code (backend and frontend) and setup instructions.

faqs.question: Does it track live filings?
faqs.answer: Yes, it tracks the latest filings from official exchanges.

faqs.question: Can I export the data?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a built-in export to CSV and Excel feature.

name: Momentum & Valuation Screener
shortDescription: Filter NIFTY 500 and S&P 500 stocks by P/E, trading volume, and RSI. Review the resulting watchlist using delayed market data.
features: Scan NIFTY 500 and S&P 500 stocks
Apply defaults of P/E below 20, volume above twice its average, and RSI above 50
Rank the stocks that match the configured filters
Sort results in an interactive watchlist
Review valuation and momentum filters in one view
whatYouGet: Complete source code (Python data engine, React frontend) and setup instructions.

faqs.question: Does it use real-time data?
faqs.answer: It uses delayed data via Yahoo Finance to find end-of-day or intraday volume spikes.

faqs.question: Can I change the filters?
faqs.answer: Yes. The source code is included, so you can edit the P/E, volume, and RSI thresholds. This requires working with the code.
